title: Samsara
description: The cycle of birth, death, and rebirth.
body:
# Samsara

Samsara is the repeating cycle of birth, life, death and rebirth.

## Concept

It is closely tied to ideas of karma and liberation.

See also: [Karma](/wiki/karma) and [Dharma](/wiki/dharma).
